exposure: breastfeeding practices (lack of, exclusive breastfeeding, early breastfeeding cessation)
outcome: acquisition and dynamics of antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs)
finding: High relative abundance of Bifidobacterium is associated with a lower ARG load, and exclusive breastfeeding in the first month accelerates ARG reduction and ensures a lower resistome burden at six months.
mod_finding: Exclusive breastfeeding is identified as a key strategy to mitigate the impact of C-section delivery on the infant gut resistome, counteracting early-life antibiotic exposure and resistance acquisition.
